2.web: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
2.asv: How long will ye vex my soul, And break me in pieces with words?

3.web: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.
3.asv: These ten times have ye reproached me: Ye are not ashamed that ye deal hardly with me.

4.web: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.
4.asv: And be it indeed that I have erred, Mine error remaineth with myself.

5.web: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach;
5.asv: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, And plead against me my reproach;

6.web: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.
6.asv: Know now that God hath subverted me in my cause, And hath compassed me with his net.

7.web: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.
7.asv: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry for help, but there is no justice.

8.web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
8.asv: He hath walled up my way that I cannot pass, And hath set darkness in my paths.

9.web: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.
9.asv: He hath stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.

10.web: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. My hope he has plucked up like a tree.
10.asv: He hath broken me down on every side, and I am gone; And my hope hath he plucked up like a tree.

11.web: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.
11.asv: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, And he counteth me unto him as one of his adversaries.

12.web: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.
12.asv: His troops come on together, And cast up their way against me, And encamp round about my tent.

13.web: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
13.asv: He hath put my brethren far from me, And mine acquaintance are wholly estranged from me.

14.web: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
14.asv: My kinsfolk have failed, And my familiar friends have forgotten me.

15.web: Those who dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.
15.asv: They that dwell in my house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

16.web: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.
16.asv: I call unto my servant, and he giveth me no answer, ThoughI entreat him with my mouth.

17.web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
17.asv: My breath is strange to my wife, And my supplication to the children of mine own mother.

18.web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
18.asv: Even young children despise me; If I arise, they speak against me.

19.web: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.
19.asv: All my familiar friends abhor me, And they whom I loved are turned against me.

20.web: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
20.asv: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, And I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

21.web: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, you my friends; for the hand of God has touched me.
21.asv: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; For the hand of God hath touched me.

22.web: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
22.asv: Why do ye persecute me as God, And are not satisfied with my flesh?

23.web: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!
23.asv: Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

24.web: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!
24.asv: That with an iron pen and lead They were graven in the rock for ever!

25.web: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
25.asv: But as for me I know that my Redeemer liveth, And at last he will stand up upon the earth:

26.web: After my skin is destroyed, then in my flesh shall I see God,
26.asv: And after my skin, eventhisbody, is destroyed, Then without my flesh shall I see God;

27.web: Whom I, even I, shall see on my side. My eyes shall see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.
27.asv: Whom I, even I, shall see, on my side, And mine eyes shall behold, and not as a stranger. My heart is consumed within me.

28.web: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,
28.asv: If ye say, How we will persecute him! And that the root of the matter is found in me;

29.web: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”
29.asv: Be ye afraid of the sword: For wrathbringeththe punishments of the sword, That ye may know there is a judgment.
